title: The Burnt Cover Revisited
author: Jude Sandoval
blurb: Freya Voss, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must extract a defector who may be the bait before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
